extension-library.description: Scaffold a customer Layer 2 extension library that contributes slots, rules, actions and components to the Satori platform.

extension-rule.description: Add a named rule evaluator to an existing extension library. A rule gates whether a surface is offered — it is not authorisation.

extension-action.description: Add an action handler to an existing extension library. Where it appears is Layer 1 configuration; what it does is the handler.

extension-component.description: Scaffold a standalone component in an existing extension library and register it by ID behind a lazy import.

satori-component.description: Add an nxs- component to the platform's own component library, registered by ID for a slot, with its spec, story, Overview page, export, reference row and with-and-without-Satori section. Internal: customers contribute with extension-component under their own prefix.

config-package.description: Scaffold a Nuxeo Marketplace package that configures Satori (Layer 0 and Layer 1 fragments), with a build target that checks the fragments and writes the installable zip.
